verdict.rationale: Sketch documents an official JavaScript API with a browsable reference of all classes and methods, and offers a 'Hello Sketch' code sample you can try directly inside the Sketch app. That is a runnable example, but it runs in the Mac app rather than in an interactive in-browser reference. The probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec, so there is no interactive try-it API explorer. Missing for 10: interactive in-docs execution of examples, a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI), broad runnable examples across the reference, independent corroboration.
